deadline.value: Applications and supporting documents are due December 15 for fall (year inferred); the same date is the financial-aid date for international applicants.
deadline.quote: Fall Admissions: The application and all supporting documents must be received by December 15.

fee_waiver.value: The school does not grant application fee waivers.
fee_waiver.quote: No, the fee is collected to help defray the cost of processing applications.

gre_general.quote: Note: GRE scores are optional for applications.

funding.value: Outstanding applicants are considered for teaching and research assistantships and fellowships; support is not stated as automatic.
funding.quote: Outstanding applicants are considered for support in the form of teaching assistantships, research assistantships, and various fellowships from the Department and the College of Engineering.

entry_route.value: Most bachelor's holders apply to the M.S. first, though highly qualified ones may request direct PhD entry; M.S. holders can enter the PhD directly.
entry_route.quote: Those holding B.S. degrees usually apply for the M.S. program, though highly qualified applicants with B.S. degrees may request immediate entry to the Ph.D. program.

also.quote: Those holding M.S. degrees from other institutions may apply for entry directly to the Ph.D. program.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The pages checked do not state a supervisor rule

notes: Department TOEFL (iBT 80/19) uses the old scale, so no department TOEFL value is set.
